Source-level payment gap candidate: PaymentStrategy.Explicit carries phyrexianLifePayments, but ActivateAbilityHandler contains no use of that field or withPhyrexianPaidByLife. Its Explicit branch uses unreduced manaCost with payPartial/solve; CostHandler mana atom only pays ManaPool. ManaSolver.canPay admits life-pip affordability, while execution solve handles color requirements. Spell casting separately validates and pays life in CastPaymentProcessor. Actual activated-ability life-payment execution must be demonstrated with a minimal unregistered test card before deciding repair; no runtime failure claimed.

Activation/payment paths inspected here are not among final protocol197protected paths. Any repair must remain bounded, preserve existing actions/payment defaults and unrelated cost behavior, and be independently compiled with executable negative controls before card acceptance.

Card discovery is automatic: placing canonical val in NPH/cards would register it. Do not add discoverable Spellskite or rebless protected snapshots while final qualification is pending.
